description.value: This study investigated the relationship between regional grey matter atrophy and attentional-control performance on a Flanker task across neurodegenerative disease groups and healthy controls.

spans.text: This study investigated the neurobiological basis of attentional control dysfunction in neurodegenerative disease by determining the effect of regional brain atrophy on Flanker task performance of neurodegenerative patients.

value: We hypothesized that atrophy in DLPFC and ACC would be significantly associated with decreased attentional control performance on the Flanker task.
